differ.description: The disciplines stay the same: service level, quality, workforce, data, governance and technology, but the pressures change. The operating model is shaped around those realities rather than a template.

catalogue.title: Eight services, one operating model
catalogue.description: Infoline's service catalogue is built around eight modular services. Each can be delivered independently or combined into one operating model, with agreed measures, governance and accountability.

services.title: CX Operations
services.headline: You own the customer. We run the operation
services.summary: End-to-end operations, service level, quality, workforce and governance
body: Recruitment, training, quality, workforce management, technology, supervision and the service level can move under one managed operating model. Delivery can be fully managed at Infoline, managed inside the client's premises, or applied to the client's existing resources through Infoline's management model.
Weekly operational reviews, monthly performance reviews and quarterly business reviews use the same agreed metrics, with an escalation ladder defined before go-live.

services.title: CX Transformation
services.headline: Find the gaps. Fix what matters. Stay accountable for improvement
services.summary: Diagnostics, journey redesign and a measurable improvement plan you can hold us to
body: We map the current operation against the outcomes you need, size the gaps that cost the most, and agree a change plan with owners, milestones and a baseline. Work spans process, quality, workforce and technology so improvements hold once we hand back.
Progress is tracked against the baseline in the same review cadence as delivery, so transformation is proven on the floor rather than in a slide.

services.title: Quality as a Service
services.headline: Quality you can defend, not just report
services.summary: Independent evaluations, calibration and coaching tied to the outcomes that matter
body: Interactions are scored against a rubric agreed with you, calibrated across evaluators, and linked to coaching so scores change behaviour rather than just fill a dashboard. Sampling can be risk-weighted so the interactions that carry the most exposure get the most attention.
Findings feed the same performance reviews as operations, with disputes and calibration logged so a score can always be defended to an auditor or an evaluation committee.

services.title: Training as a Service
services.headline: Build capability, certify it, then prove it on the floor
services.summary: Onboarding, product and soft-skills training with certification and floor validation
body: New hires and existing teams move through structured onboarding, product and process training, and soft-skills development, each closed out with an assessment. Content is built with your subject-matter experts and kept current as products and policies change.
Certification is validated against live performance in the first weeks on the floor, so training is measured by what changes in the operation, not by attendance.

services.title: Business Intelligence
services.headline: One version of the numbers. Clearer decisions
services.summary: Governed reporting, dashboards and analysis across the operation
body: We consolidate operational, quality and workforce data into one governed model, so leaders work from a single set of numbers instead of reconciling spreadsheets. Dashboards are built around the decisions you actually make, with definitions agreed and documented.
Beyond dashboards, analysts investigate the drivers behind a trend — what is moving handle time, first-contact resolution or attrition — and package it for the same business reviews.

services.title: Workforce Management
services.headline: Right people. Right interval. Right service level
services.summary: Forecasting, scheduling and real-time management against the service level
body: Demand is forecast from history and known drivers, translated into schedules that fit your operating rules, and managed in real time so intraday changes do not cost the service level. Shrinkage, adherence and occupancy are tracked and fed back into the next forecast.
Capacity plans flex with demand, and staffing scenarios for peaks, launches or growth are modelled before they are committed.

services.title: Technology Services
services.headline: Connected channels, in-country options and AI where it helps
services.summary: Contact platform, integrations and automation, delivered and supported
body: Voice, digital and messaging channels run on a connected platform, integrated with your systems so agents and reporting see one customer. In-country hosting options are available where data residency matters, and automation or AI is applied only where it measurably helps.
The platform is delivered and supported by Infoline, with change management and monitoring inside the same governance as the operation.

services.title: HR Outsourcing
services.headline: You direct the work. We manage the employment
services.summary: Recruitment, payroll and employee administration under a compliant model
body: Infoline manages recruitment, onboarding, payroll and day-to-day employee administration while you direct the work itself. The employment relationship, compliance and administration sit with us, reducing the operating burden on your team.
Reporting on headcount, cost and compliance runs in the same cadence as the rest of the operation, so workforce decisions are made with current information.

partner.title: Build trusted solutions with Infoline
partner.description: Have a platform, capability or solution that strengthens customer operations in Oman? We are open to strategic and technology partnerships where the fit is clear.

items.q: Can Infoline run only part of our operation?
items.a: Yes. Each of the eight services can be delivered on its own or combined into one operating model. Delivery can sit fully at Infoline, inside your premises, or be applied to your existing team through Infoline's management model.

Against metrics agreed before go-live. Weekly operational reviews, monthly performance reviews and quarterly business reviews use the same numbers, with an escalation ladder defined up front so nothing is measured after the fact.
Voice, live chat, WhatsApp, IVR, email and ticketing run on one connected platform, integrated with your systems so agents and reporting see a single customer.
Yes. In-country hosting options are available where data residency matters, and the arrangement is agreed as part of the operating model and its governance.
